title: Z After: A Point and Click Survival
summary: Z After is a Narrative Zombie Survival Point and Click Adventure game with Hidden Object and Turn-based fighting mechanics.
about:
ABOUT THIS GAME 

Z After is a survival hidden objects game with zombies, guns and you guessed it, survival.

 

Fight through seven stages of hand-drawn areas in a narrative-driven storyline to figure out your role in the zombie apocalypse. Gather weapons, ammo, and armor to help defend yourself in a turn-based tactical combat phase which will allow you to gather materials and fortify buildings to help thwart the oncoming horde.

 

Unlock multiple characters with unique talents that make each playthrough a different experience altogether.



•	100+ individual pieces of gear to find (common, uncommon, rare). 

•	100+ interactive objects with layers. 

•	Unique, hand-drawn exterior/interior interactive environments.

•	Exploration and Battle phases. 

•	Original soundtrack!

•	Multiple characters with concurrent storylines that lead up to a surprise ending. 

•	Randomly generated item locations for great replayability.
